This episode supplies ordinary preferences and hesitant request behavior, not global incompetence or reciprocal romance.

Yunyun refuses an actual walk invitation while invoking rivalry, then regrets separation in observed posture and protests Megumin's account. This is a contrary case to unconditional inclusion acceptance. She reports paying Funifura/Dodonko after friendship language; actual historic expenditures are her report. Megumin's provocations and Yunyun grabbing/protesting are not harmless proof of covert benevolence.

Yunyun acknowledges the assigned Teleport/back-up role and actually supplies withdrawal magic in the campaign montage. She explicitly objects that the group resembles the Demon Army while Kazuma and Megumin continue attacks amid surrender/mercy claims.
